def solution():
    # Define variables and values
    principal = 20000
    annual_interest_rate = 0.055
    years = 5

    # Calculate the monthly payment and first month's interest
    monthly_rate = annual_interest_rate / 12
    number_of_payments = years * 12
    monthly_payment = (principal * monthly_rate) / (
        1 - (1 + monthly_rate) ** -number_of_payments
    )
    first_month_interest = principal * monthly_rate

    # The remainder of the first payment reduces the principal
    principal_paid = round(monthly_payment - first_month_interest, 2)

    return principal_paid
